body.system: You are a test assistant. Use the tools when the user asks for them.

messages.content: Think step by step: is 391 a prime number? If it is, call get_weather for Paris, otherwise for Rome. Then, after thinking about the result, tell me in one sentence whether I need an umbrella.

391 = 17 × 23, so it isn't prime, and I checked Rome. The weather tool returned data for Paris (18 °C, cloudy), not Rome, so I don't have Rome's actual conditions. Going by that Paris result, which may not apply, it's cloudy with no rain reported, so you probably don't need an umbrella. I can retry the Rome lookup if you want to be sure.
Call get_time and tell me the time.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get the current weather for a city.

tools.name: get_time
tools.description: Get the current UTC time. Takes no arguments.
